QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` (line 85) hides the value from the compiler. With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))`. Without it, it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`, a `volatile` global, so the compiler cannot prove the value is constant.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the barrier that hides values from the compiler, and its section on `library/constant_time_impl.h` puts it in that file (line 85).
